passages.text:
### Case Study: Water Resource Management & Cistern Filling
A community water harvesting initiative in an arid village uses an ancient system of multi-rate inlet fountains and canals. Four natural conduits fill a central community cistern. The first fountain takes 1 full day to fill the cistern alone, the second takes  rac{1}{2} day, the third takes  rac{1}{4} day, and the fourth takes  rac{1}{5} day. In addition, an auxiliary supply canal of length 1	ext{ km} is being constructed by a team of workers in 8 days at a uniform rate.

### Case Study: Architectural Design and Triangulation
An architectural model involves interlocking triangles and parallel support beams. Structural engineers must ensure the structural integrity of triangular roof trusses by verifying the triangle inequality theorem and calculating missing angles formed by intersecting struts and parallel horizontal purlins.

diagram.description: Two parallel lines l and m intersected by transversal t, showing interior angles 3 and 6 on the same side.
diagram.code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))
ax.set_aspect('equal')
x = np.linspace(-1, 6, 100)
ax.plot(x, 0x + 3, color='#2563EB', lw=2, label='line l')
ax.plot(x, 0x + 1, color='#2563EB', lw=2, label='line m')
xt = np.linspace(1, 4, 100)
yt = -1.5 * xt + 5.5
ax.plot(xt, yt, color='#DC2626', lw=2, label='transversal t')
ax.text(5.5, 3.2, '$l$', color='#0F172A', fontsize=12, ha='center', va='bottom')
ax.text(5.5, 1.2, '$m$', color='#0F172A', fontsize=12, ha='center', va='bottom')
ax.text(2.2, 2.7, '$50^{\circ}$', color='#0F172A', fontsize=11, ha='left', va='top')
ax.text(3.3, 1.3, '$\angle 6$', color='#DC2626', fontsize=11, ha='left', va='bottom')
ax.set_xlim(-1, 6)
ax.set_ylim(-0.5, 4.5)
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('diagram.svg', format='svg', bbox_inches='tight')

questions.explanation: The parity pattern is T₁(O), T₂(E), T₃(O), T₄(O), T₅(E), T₆(O), \dots. The pattern of length 3 is (O, E, O). Since 20 \equiv 2 ±od 3, the 20	ext{th} term has the parity of T₂, which is Even.
